Pools and concepts

Biology terms, general words matched to them, and concept groups

What In this run
Subject pool candidates labelled T3 (biology term) 789, of which 306 multiword
General pool candidates labelled T1 (everyday) or T2 (school vocabulary) 3188: 1480 T1, 1708 T2
Matching one general word per term: same part of speech, closest in general frequency and length 514 terms have a partner
Concepts terms that name the same thing (variants, synonyms, a noun and its adjective) 636, of which 122 group several terms

How the pools are built: Method. Labels come from language models; rows with do_przegladu = True had no majority. Filter with the boxes under the header, click a header to sort, Columns shows hidden columns.

  • Subject pool (T3)
  • General pool (T1/T2)
  • Concepts
  • Terms the extraction missed

Source file: pula_przedmiotowa.csv (view · download).

NoteColumn glossary
Column Meaning
forma_podstawowa Base (dictionary) form of the item. Equal to forma_kandydata unless the models corrected a wrong base form (same number of words only).
pojecie Concept the term belongs to. Terms that are variants, synonyms or derivatives of one concept share the label; a term without a group is its own concept.
obrazowalnosc Model judgement whether the concept can be shown in a picture or diagram (tak, czesciowo, nie).
dopasowanie_ogolne General-pool item matched to this term (same stratum, closest frequency and length); empty if no item lies within the calipers.
dopasowanie_delta_zipf Zipf frequency of the term minus that of its match.
dopasowanie_delta_liter Letters of the term minus letters of its match.
dlugosc Number of words.
pos Part of speech used for matching: rzeczownik noun, przymiotnik adjective, czasownik verb, przysłówek adverb, fraza multiword, inne other.
n_liter Letters in forma_podstawowa, spaces not counted.
zipf_dopasowania Frequency used for matching: zipf_kwjp for single words, zipf_zpe for phrases.
forma_kandydata The candidate exactly as extracted in step 4. All counts, scores and ranks in the row were computed for this string.
lematy Lemmas of the candidate’s words, in order (the key used to count occurrences).
cls Inflectional class of the lemma from Morfeusz2 (subst noun, adj adjective, ger gerund, ppas/pact participles, fin/inf/praet verb forms, adv adverb); mwu for multiword candidates.
kand_przedmiotowy Candidate from the target corpus (passed the subject thresholds).
kand_ogolny Candidate from the whole stage corpus, spread over several contrast subjects (source of T1/T2 items).
freq_cel Occurrences in the target corpus (biology).
freq_kontrast Occurrences in the contrast corpus (other subjects of the same school stage).
n_mat_cel Number of target materials containing the candidate.
n_mat_kontrast Number of contrast materials containing the candidate.
n_przedmiotow Number of contrast subjects in which the candidate occurs (dispersion).
n_klas_cel Number of distinct estimated grades among target materials containing the candidate.
udzial_nazw_wlasnych Share of occurrences tagged as a proper name.
freq_kwjp Lemma frequency in KWJP100 (general Polish, CC BY 4.0), summed over inflectional classes; gerunds and participles are counted from the verb’s entry. Empty for multiword candidates.
zipf_kwjp Zipf frequency in KWJP100: log₁₀ of occurrences per billion words (single words only).
zipf_wordfreq Zipf frequency from wordfreq (0 = not found; single words only).
zipf_zpe Zipf frequency in the whole stage corpus of ZPE (target + contrast); available for multiword candidates too.
ll_vs_kontrast Log-likelihood keyness, target vs contrast corpus; negative when relatively rarer in biology.
log_ratio_kontrast Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs contrast (smoothing 0.5).
ll_vs_kwjp Log-likelihood keyness against KWJP100 (single words).
log_ratio_kwjp Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs KWJP100 (single words).
simple_maths_kwjp Kilgarriff’s Simple Maths keyness against KWJP100 (per-million rates, N = 1; single words).
tfidf_biol Relative frequency in biology × log(1 + subjects / (1 + n_przedmiotow)).
rozproszenie Same value as n_przedmiotow (higher = more cross-subject).
pmi Multiword candidates: lowest pointwise mutual information among adjacent word pairs of the phrase.
logdice Multiword candidates: lowest logDice among adjacent word pairs of the phrase.
cvalue TermoPL C-value on the target corpus (empty = not returned by TermoPL).
termopl_ok Whether TermoPL ran successfully in this run.
rank_ll_vs_kontrast Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kontrast (1 = best).
rank_log_ratio_kontrast Rank of the candidate by log_ratio_kontrast (1 = best).
rank_simple_maths_kwjp Rank of the candidate by simple_maths_kwjp (1 = best).
rank_ll_vs_kwjp Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kwjp (1 = best).
rank_tfidf_biol Rank of the candidate by tfidf_biol (1 = best).
rank_pmi Rank of the candidate by pmi (1 = best).
rank_logdice Rank of the candidate by logdice (1 = best).
rank_cvalue Rank of the candidate by cvalue (1 = best).
rrf Reciprocal-rank fusion of the method rankings (higher = ranked high by several methods).
rank_rrf Rank of the candidate by rrf (1 = best).
etykieta_regulowa Rule-based pre-label from dispersion and frequency thresholds (T3?, T2?, T1?, nierozstrzygniete). Kept for comparison only; not shown to the models and not used for the pools.
srebrny_slowniczek True if the candidate is an entry of a ZPE glossary in the target materials.
srebrny_pojecie_ref True if the candidate is a base form written by ZPE editors for a linked term.
kategoria_final Same as kategoria, empty when the candidate was not sent to the models.
typ_szumu For SZUM: fragment_terminu part of a longer term, luzne_polaczenie free word combination, nazwa_wlasna proper name, blad_ekstrakcji extraction error, interfejs platform interface or instruction text, inne other; brak for all other labels.
pelny_termin For fragments of a term: the full term the fragment belongs to, as given by the model.
zgodnosc_glosow How many of the votes carry the final label (for example 2 z 2, 2 z 3).
do_przegladu True if no label had a majority among the models, or the adjudicator itself reported low confidence.
model_sedzia Adjudicating model, where the case was adjudicated.
sonnet_5_5_kategoria Label from Claude Sonnet 5.5.
sonnet_5_5_pewnosc Self-reported confidence of Claude Sonnet 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).
sonnet_5_5_uzasadnienie One-sentence reason given by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (in Polish).
opus_5_5_kategoria Label from Claude Opus 5.5.
opus_5_5_pewnosc Self-reported confidence of Claude Opus 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).
opus_5_5_uzasadnienie One-sentence reason given by Claude Opus 5.5 (in Polish).
sedzia_kategoria Label from the adjudicating model.
sedzia_pewnosc Self-reported confidence of the adjudicating model (wysoka, srednia, niska).
sedzia_uzasadnienie One-sentence reason given by the adjudicating model (in Polish).
kategoria Final label from step 5: T3 biology term, T3_INNY term of another school subject, T2 school / academic vocabulary, T1 everyday vocabulary, SZUM not usable as a test item; nieklasyfikowany = not sent to the models (in neither pool).
duplikat_formy Filled when another row has the same forma_podstawowa after correction and is the main row for it (this row is then left out of the pools).
freq_cel_laczna Occurrences in the target corpus summed over all warianty.
freq_kontrast_laczna Occurrences in the contrast corpus summed over all warianty.
warianty All candidate strings that name this item after correction (for example odwłok; odwłoka, one lemma split by a tagging error).
warstwa Matching stratum: part of speech for single words, fraza 2 / fraza 3 for multiword items.

NoteColumn glossary
Column Meaning
forma_podstawowa Base (dictionary) form of the item. Equal to forma_kandydata unless the models corrected a wrong base form (same number of words only).
kategoria Final label from step 5: T3 biology term, T3_INNY term of another school subject, T2 school / academic vocabulary, T1 everyday vocabulary, SZUM not usable as a test item; nieklasyfikowany = not sent to the models (in neither pool).
dopasowanie_przedmiotowe Subject term this general-pool item is matched to.
dlugosc Number of words.
pos Part of speech used for matching: rzeczownik noun, przymiotnik adjective, czasownik verb, przysłówek adverb, fraza multiword, inne other.
n_liter Letters in forma_podstawowa, spaces not counted.
zipf_dopasowania Frequency used for matching: zipf_kwjp for single words, zipf_zpe for phrases.
forma_kandydata The candidate exactly as extracted in step 4. All counts, scores and ranks in the row were computed for this string.
lematy Lemmas of the candidate’s words, in order (the key used to count occurrences).
cls Inflectional class of the lemma from Morfeusz2 (subst noun, adj adjective, ger gerund, ppas/pact participles, fin/inf/praet verb forms, adv adverb); mwu for multiword candidates.
kand_przedmiotowy Candidate from the target corpus (passed the subject thresholds).
kand_ogolny Candidate from the whole stage corpus, spread over several contrast subjects (source of T1/T2 items).
freq_cel Occurrences in the target corpus (biology).
freq_kontrast Occurrences in the contrast corpus (other subjects of the same school stage).
n_mat_cel Number of target materials containing the candidate.
n_mat_kontrast Number of contrast materials containing the candidate.
n_przedmiotow Number of contrast subjects in which the candidate occurs (dispersion).
n_klas_cel Number of distinct estimated grades among target materials containing the candidate.
udzial_nazw_wlasnych Share of occurrences tagged as a proper name.
freq_kwjp Lemma frequency in KWJP100 (general Polish, CC BY 4.0), summed over inflectional classes; gerunds and participles are counted from the verb’s entry. Empty for multiword candidates.
zipf_kwjp Zipf frequency in KWJP100: log₁₀ of occurrences per billion words (single words only).
zipf_wordfreq Zipf frequency from wordfreq (0 = not found; single words only).
zipf_zpe Zipf frequency in the whole stage corpus of ZPE (target + contrast); available for multiword candidates too.
ll_vs_kontrast Log-likelihood keyness, target vs contrast corpus; negative when relatively rarer in biology.
log_ratio_kontrast Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs contrast (smoothing 0.5).
ll_vs_kwjp Log-likelihood keyness against KWJP100 (single words).
log_ratio_kwjp Log₂ ratio of relative frequencies, target vs KWJP100 (single words).
simple_maths_kwjp Kilgarriff’s Simple Maths keyness against KWJP100 (per-million rates, N = 1; single words).
tfidf_biol Relative frequency in biology × log(1 + subjects / (1 + n_przedmiotow)).
rozproszenie Same value as n_przedmiotow (higher = more cross-subject).
pmi Multiword candidates: lowest pointwise mutual information among adjacent word pairs of the phrase.
logdice Multiword candidates: lowest logDice among adjacent word pairs of the phrase.
cvalue TermoPL C-value on the target corpus (empty = not returned by TermoPL).
termopl_ok Whether TermoPL ran successfully in this run.
rank_ll_vs_kontrast Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kontrast (1 = best).
rank_log_ratio_kontrast Rank of the candidate by log_ratio_kontrast (1 = best).
rank_simple_maths_kwjp Rank of the candidate by simple_maths_kwjp (1 = best).
rank_ll_vs_kwjp Rank of the candidate by ll_vs_kwjp (1 = best).
rank_tfidf_biol Rank of the candidate by tfidf_biol (1 = best).
rank_pmi Rank of the candidate by pmi (1 = best).
rank_logdice Rank of the candidate by logdice (1 = best).
rank_cvalue Rank of the candidate by cvalue (1 = best).
rrf Reciprocal-rank fusion of the method rankings (higher = ranked high by several methods).
rank_rrf Rank of the candidate by rrf (1 = best).
etykieta_regulowa Rule-based pre-label from dispersion and frequency thresholds (T3?, T2?, T1?, nierozstrzygniete). Kept for comparison only; not shown to the models and not used for the pools.
srebrny_slowniczek True if the candidate is an entry of a ZPE glossary in the target materials.
srebrny_pojecie_ref True if the candidate is a base form written by ZPE editors for a linked term.
kategoria_final Same as kategoria, empty when the candidate was not sent to the models.
typ_szumu For SZUM: fragment_terminu part of a longer term, luzne_polaczenie free word combination, nazwa_wlasna proper name, blad_ekstrakcji extraction error, interfejs platform interface or instruction text, inne other; brak for all other labels.
pelny_termin For fragments of a term: the full term the fragment belongs to, as given by the model.
obrazowalnosc Model judgement whether the concept can be shown in a picture or diagram (tak, czesciowo, nie).
zgodnosc_glosow How many of the votes carry the final label (for example 2 z 2, 2 z 3).
do_przegladu True if no label had a majority among the models, or the adjudicator itself reported low confidence.
model_sedzia Adjudicating model, where the case was adjudicated.
sonnet_5_5_kategoria Label from Claude Sonnet 5.5.
sonnet_5_5_pewnosc Self-reported confidence of Claude Sonnet 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).
sonnet_5_5_uzasadnienie One-sentence reason given by Claude Sonnet 5.5 (in Polish).
opus_5_5_kategoria Label from Claude Opus 5.5.
opus_5_5_pewnosc Self-reported confidence of Claude Opus 5.5 (wysoka, srednia, niska).
opus_5_5_uzasadnienie One-sentence reason given by Claude Opus 5.5 (in Polish).
sedzia_kategoria Label from the adjudicating model.
sedzia_pewnosc Self-reported confidence of the adjudicating model (wysoka, srednia, niska).
sedzia_uzasadnienie One-sentence reason given by the adjudicating model (in Polish).
duplikat_formy Filled when another row has the same forma_podstawowa after correction and is the main row for it (this row is then left out of the pools).
freq_cel_laczna Occurrences in the target corpus summed over all warianty.
freq_kontrast_laczna Occurrences in the contrast corpus summed over all warianty.
warianty All candidate strings that name this item after correction (for example odwłok; odwłoka, one lemma split by a tagging error).
warstwa Matching stratum: part of speech for single words, fraza 2 / fraza 3 for multiword items.

NoteColumn glossary
Column Meaning
pojecie Concept the term belongs to. Terms that are variants, synonyms or derivatives of one concept share the label; a term without a group is its own concept.
terminy Subject-pool terms grouped under the concept, most frequent first.
n_terminow Number of terms in the group.
obrazowalnosc Model judgement whether the concept can be shown in a picture or diagram (tak, czesciowo, nie).
freq_cel_suma Occurrences of all terms of the concept in the target corpus.
n_mat_cel_max Largest number of target materials among the terms of the concept.
dopasowanie_ogolne General-pool item matched to this term (same stratum, closest frequency and length); empty if no item lies within the calipers.
